---
title: "5 · Unsupervised Learning and Phase Diagrams without Labels"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Learning without labels: principal component analysis, t-SNE, k-means and DBSCAN clustering, and autoencoders whose reconstruction error detects anomalies. Anomaly detection for phase diagrams. The 2D Ising model: finite-size scaling, Swendsen–Wang cluster updates, the first principal component as the magnetisation, and autoencoders whose signal sharpens towards T_c with the lattice size, depending on the training region. The frustrated J1–J2 model: ground states, frustration and mean field, PCA finding both order parameters, and the phase diagram recovered by autoencoders trained on three corners, from a coarse scan.
